name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage exploration and development company focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The Diablillos deposit hosts Proven and Probable Mineral Reserves of approximately 124 Moz silver and 1.1 Moz gold across 42.3 Mt of ore. The company is advancing the project through development studies toward a construction decision.
